sections.title: Keys: Lesson 14, LLM architecture and training

keyTerms.definition: The transformer components used in large language models.
Next-token prediction with cross-entropy loss over positions and sequences.

recall.question: Which two topics do the Lesson 14 keys cover?

keyTerms.definition: One symbol the model reads: a word, word piece, punctuation, byte, or special marker.
The joint probability factored as p(x_1) p(x_2|x_1) and on through p(x_T|x_1 to x_{T-1}).
Mean cross-entropy of the next-token logits averaged over positions and sequences.
Scores from softmax(q_t k_j^T over sqrt(d_h)) weight a sum over value vectors.
Dividing by sqrt(d_h) keeps logit variance near 1 so the softmax does not saturate.
A mask of 0 for j at most t and minus infinity for j above t, added before the softmax.

recall.question: What does BPE do?
recall.answer: It starts from bytes or characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent adjacent pair, giving a subword vocabulary.

recall.question: Why divide attention scores by sqrt(d_h)?
recall.answer: At initialization the q-k dot product has variance d_h. Without scaling the softmax saturates and gradients vanish.

recall.question: What does the causal mask guarantee?
recall.answer: Position t sees only the current and past tokens, which is the autoregressive property.

keyTerms.definition: The numeric check that attention rows are [1,0,0], [0.3302,0.6698,0], and [0.4011,0.4011,0.1978].
Perturb future tokens and assert u_t is unchanged to verify the causal mask.
Per-layer KV cache at T equals 8192 fp16: MHA 128.0 MiB, GQA 32.0 MiB, MQA 4.0 MiB.
Grouped-query attention, the middle ground between MHA quality and MQA cache size.

recall.question: How do you catch a missing causal mask?
recall.answer: Perturb future tokens and assert u_t is unchanged. Check the exact zero triangle on random inputs.

recall.question: When is sliding window attention appropriate?
recall.answer: When the task is local and long-range context can be dropped for a bounded cache.

keyTerms.definition: The t-th row of softmax_row(Q K^T over c) V is exactly the weighted value sum with the causal mask.
Lower tau sharpens the distribution; tau equals 0.5 puts 0.8282 on the top token.

recall.question: What does top-p 0.9 keep at tau equals 1?

keyTerms.definition: Near-zero training loss after one epoch, but incoherent text at generation.
Its absence or misplacement lets the model see the future during training.

recall.question: Why does near-zero loss after one epoch mean trouble?
recall.answer: The model sees the future because the causal mask is absent or misplaced, or labels leak into inputs. At generation there is no future to read.

keyTerms.definition: Wins when there are no labels, the task is well described in words, and iteration must be instant.
Wins when 5,000 pairs exist and the output format or style needs to be reliable.

recall.question: What does the SFT loss mask buy?
recall.answer: Answer-only training: capacity goes to p(y|x), not to prediction of the prompt.

keyTerms.definition: As n_g falls from n_h to 1, long-context quality stays flat to a threshold and then drops.
The number of KV heads, which grows with the task's dependence on distant context.

recall.question: What does the E11 claim predict about n_g?
recall.answer: Long-context quality is flat down to some threshold n_g and then drops, and n_g grows with dependence on distant context.

keyTerms.definition: The attention toy, cache table, and temperature and top-p values all match E08.
The cache table matches 128.0, 32.0, and 4.0 MiB per layer at T equals 8192.

recall.question: What verifies the lab-08 implementation?
recall.answer: The attention toy matches the three rows, the cache table matches 128.0, 32.0, and 4.0 MiB per layer at T equals 8192, and the temperature and top-p values match E08.
